newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks lose ground eyeing Wall St at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks lose ground eyeing Wall St at close.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended lower on Tuesday, reversing earlier gains in line with weakness in bonds and on Wall Street, dealers said.
The general index fell 0.66 points, 0.14 percent, to 481.29 and the Ibex shed 3.99 points, 0.07 percent, to 5,505.15.
The bourse is seen shifting lower short-term based on closing positions, dealers said.
Santander continued to gain, adding 140 pesetas to 9,760, while Telefonica rose 5 pesetas to 3,365 after the sale of government's last 20.9 percent stake ended, considered highly successful.
A lack of corporate news is contributing to a dull and somewhat unstable climate in the bourse, dealers said, and movement continues to be dominated by technical factors.
But this should be short-lived as more results are released this and next week, they said.
